name: readout-corr-planted
cmd: set -e; for g in z spacetime mix_0.6 mix_0.3; do {python} research/exp/readout_corr.py --cache {cache}/planted_v2_tempho1995 --out {out}/$g --population withheld --species-regex "^${g}_" > /dev/null; done
summarize: for g in z spacetime mix_0.6 mix_0.3; do echo "== $g"; {python} research/exp/readout_corr.py --summarize {out}/$g; done
note: verification (a) for E013: planted generators (z must be recovered, unrelated fields must read ~0)
